items.question: Under what constraint are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of womb-diagrams is specified here.
Those womb-diagrams are said to contain tormented beings.
The location marks a bounded field of suffering.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within the specified set of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent of torment is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
